1.1.1.description:
mostly bugfixes and apworld housecleaning
 - fix issue where this game's "Non-Matching ROM error" will show up when youre trying to play a completely different game entirely
 - added more complete regions for checks
 - fix issue where the first level of Let's Shop mode could still be attempted when 0 shopping levels were unlocked
   - For now, the game will just set the timer to 0 if it detects that the player has done this. this is one of those things that ASM hacking will be great for
 - fixed an issue where the saved bonus count didnt get cleared when setting up for a new AP
 - all bonuses, including Extra bonuses from the multiworld and natural bonuses that you get from recipe step minigames, are now cleared upon recipe completion if all bonus checks have been obtained
   - Bonuses are entirely useless in this AP after you get the checks, so this is to make playing the game less annoying
1.1.1.title: Cooking Mama 3 AP v1.1.1

1.1.2.description:
logic fixes to comply with the Ionium fuzzing tests.

 - Fix copy-paste errors that made it so that the Cooking Contest region looked at the *shopping mode* option in the yaml
 - When the goal includes # of recipes or gold medals, the Secret Recipes (and therefore the Ingredient items) are now taken into consideration for goal logic
1.1.2.title: Cooking Mama 3 AP v1.1.2

1.1.3.description:
two more minor fixes, to enhance your Cooking Mama 3 experience:
 - Cooking Contest location checks are now in the correct location group
 - All OptionErrors have been moved to be raised in generate_early
   - This makes them raise much earlier. big multiworlds could be stopped pretty late into generation if these errors were raised. This mitigates that
1.1.3.title: Cooking Mama 3 AP v1.1.3

1.1.4.description: Fixes issue where other games on Bizhawk Client could cause a UnicodeDecodeError if this apworld is installed
1.1.4.title: Cooking Mama 3 AP v1.1.4
